# Bitter espresso guide

Espresso tastes bitter when it is over-extracted. Grind size, dose and time are the main levers.

## Why does espresso taste bitter?

Over-extraction pulls harsh compounds from the coffee. A shot that runs longer than 30 seconds often tastes bitter, according to [the Specialty Coffee Association](https://example.org/research).

- Grind too fine
- Dose too high
- Water too hot

## Settings that work

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Dose | 18 g |
| Time | 28 s |
